senses.zh: 更好的，较好的（good 的比较级）
更好地，更（well 的比较级）
（身体、心情）好些的，好转的（feel better）

example.en: Can playing video games help you get a better job?
example.zh: 玩电子游戏能帮你找到更好的工作吗？

better.note: 口径：修饰动词、或修饰 able 等形容词（better able to、to better understand）标 1（副词）；作表语、定语、宾补（look better、made it better、Even better, ...）标 0；feel better 标 2。had better / 'd better 标 P:had better；「the + 比较级…, the better」（the simpler the better）标 P:the more..., the better；better off 标 P:better off；get the better of 标 P:get the better of。Better Cotton 等名称标 X。

senses.zh: 做，进行（与名词搭配：made a decision / a mistake / progress / a payment）
使，让（made sb do / made sth + 形容词）
（be made of / from）由…制成，由…构成
成为，适合当（made a good teacher）

example.en: The payment was made on Wednesday.
example.zh: 这笔款项是周三支付的。

made.form: make 的过去式和过去分词
made.note: 口径：made + 动作名词（decision, mistake, progress, effort, attempt, purchase, payment, landing, visit, call, comparison, connection）标 0；被动的 be made + 形容词/to do 也是「使」，标 1；be made of/from 标 3，made into（被改编成）标 2，made by hand/made in a lab 标 2；made voice recordings / computer models 按「制作」标 2。短语：make a difference（含 made no difference）、make use of（含 use is made of）、make one's way、make it（成功；赶上）、make headlines、make friends（含 made a new friend）、make a fuss、make history、make a career out of、be made up of、make sense、make sure、make up、make up one's mind 标 P。make a mess / make every effort 按 0 标。

senses.zh: 看见，看到；观看（电影、节目）
明白，理解，看出（I see 我明白了；you see 你知道）
看看，查看，弄清楚（see if / whether / how）
把…看作，认为（see A as B）
见面，看望；（医生）诊治（病人）
经历，遭遇（某时期、某地出现某事）

example.en: He can see the speakers' images.
example.zh: 他能看到讲话人的影像。

see.note: 口径：I see / you see / See, …（话语标记）/ as you can see / see value in / don't see why 都标 1；see if/whether/how/what（去看看、查明）标 2；see A as B 标 3；see a doctor、see sb（去见）标 4；主语是时间/地点/人群、宾语是变化或事件（We see more droughts; will see a higher price / significant hits）标 5；see that（确保）标 6，see to it that 标 P:see to it that。see you（再见）、let me see（让我想想）、see through（看穿）、see sb off（送行）标 P。

example.en: She helped the village to become famous.

become.note: 口径：后接形容词、过去分词（become famous / privatized / aware of）标 0；后接名词短语（become a star, become part of it, become the norm, become the best）或作 strive to become 的宾语为名词时标 1；what has become of sb 标 P:become of。

senses.zh: 上学，上课，学业（不带冠词：at / in / after school, start / finish school）

example.en: He is a primary school teacher.

school.note: 口径（请 C 照此执行）：high school（含 senior high school、high-school diploma、XX High School 校名）一律标 P:high school；primary / secondary / elementary / grade / boarding school 及其他校名（Lakeview School）按 0 标，不标 X；不带冠词、指上学这件事的 school（at / in / after school, after-school, school run, attend / start / begin / finish school, first day of school）标 1，但 at/in/since primary school 这类带学段修饰的按 0；作定语（school bus, school performance, school costs, school year）按 0；大学下属学院（business school, law / medical school, Graduate School of Education, School of Management）标 2。我把 high school 定为短语是因为「高中」值得整体记，请复核是否认可。

senses.zh: 领域，…界；（某种）天地（business world, online world）

example.en: Early zoos are found all over the world.
example.zh: 早期的动物园遍布世界各地。

world.note: 口径：World Health Organization、World Cup、World War II、World Bank、World Pipe Band Championships、书名 The 5-Factor World Diet 等专名里的 World 标 X；the real world、the world around us、a perfect world、the world lost…（世人）都标 0；business / working / money / online / natural world 及「一个不同的天地」标 1；绕地球（driving around the world 70 times）标 2；a world apart 标 P:a world apart，a world of（大量）标 P:a world of，what/why in the world 标 P:in the world。

important.note: 口径：修饰人、指身份地位（important people / politicians，the most important person in the room）标 1，其余（含 Most important, / more important, 作插入语「更重要的是」）标 0。
